svg.aria-label: Proton Calendar on the left, Calendar.app and Thunderbird on the right, Neutron Calendar Bridge in between as a bridge carrying a CalDAV server on your Mac; arrows both ways for two-way sync
svg.text: everything inside the dashed line happens on your Mac — your calendars never pass through anyone else’s server
signs in to Proton, keeps an encrypted local copy,
and serves it as a CalDAV server on 127.0.0.1 — two-way
